Comprehension Passage.passage: Samir lived in a small village beside a wide river. Every morning, he walked to the river with his grandfather to feed the ducks. One day, Samir saw a tiny duckling stuck between two heavy stones. It was crying softly. Samir tried to pull it out, but his hands were too big. He ran to his grandfather and called loudly for help. His grandfather brought a long stick and gently moved one stone aside. The duckling hopped free and quacked happily. Samir smiled and carried it back to its mother. The mother duck waddled around him in a circle, as if she was saying thank you. From that day, Samir brought extra bread for the ducks every morning. He learned that a little kindness can make a big difference to someone in trouble.
Comprehension Passage.main_question: Read the passage and answer the questions
